idea_name: Synchronized multi-symbol ATR with true-bar gate
mechanism: Attach iATR handles for chart symbol plus five inputs (default GBPUSD,AUDUSD,NZDUSD,USDCAD,USDCHF); copy ATR by bar time; emit EMPTY_VALUE until first 'true' TF bar (adjacent CopyTime deltas equal PeriodSeconds) so hybrid daily/minute history does not fake current-TF volatility; plot six ATR lines vs horizontal point levels.
data_needed: OHLC history per symbol on chart Period(); iATR(period) handles; SeriesInfoInteger FIRSTDATE/SYNCHRONIZED; terminal max bars
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: chart symbol + GBPUSD,AUDUSD,NZDUSD,USDCAD,USDCHF; demo on M20 and any chart TF
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a cross-asset ATR panel with explicit true-bar gating so volatility comparisons are TF-honest rather than polluted by coarser history.
quote: The major issues arising in the course of development of a multi-symbol indicator have to do with the synchronization of other symbols' data with respect to the current symbol, the lack of some indicator data and the identification of the beginning of 'true' bars of a given time frame.

idea_name: Multi-symbol price divergence from common reset point
mechanism: Overlay five peer symbols' OHLC (line/bars/candles) on the host chart after subtracting a common start open (draggable vertical line, or Month/Week/Day/Hour period open). Divergence = path of each symbol's demeaned series vs host; optional inverse for USD-base peers so quote direction aligns.
data_needed: Synchronized MqlRates per symbol on chart TF; higher-TF opens for period resets; drag line time for VERTICAL_LINE mode
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD host with GBPUSD,AUDUSD,NZDUSD,USDCAD,USDCHF; demos W1 Vertical-line and M30 Day modes
why_new_for_mis: Turns relative FX basket drift into a continuous multi-series divergence sensor MIS can threshold for cross-pair decoupling/recoupling.
quote: By dragging this line you specify the bar where prices of all symbols will meet in a single point. The open price of specified bar for the current symbol will be considered as a reference point of this meeting.

mechanism: When a peer has the common currency as base (e.g. USDCHF vs EURUSD host), flip OHLC via open-anchored negation so plotted moves share the host's quote polarity; recompute inverse_difference at each period reset.
data_needed: Per-symbol Inverse flag; open at divergence start; OHLC of peer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDCAD/USDCHF inverted vs EURUSD; M30 Day mode example
why_new_for_mis: Makes MIS basket sensors polarity-consistent across base/quote flips without separate inverse-pair feeds.
quote: Inversion means that the symbol data will be rendered upside down. This can be useful, when the list of the symbols analyzed includes currency pairs in which the same currency (for example, US dollar) can be both the base one and the counter one.

idea_name: Kagi Yin/Yang thickness as trend-regime sensor
mechanism: Build time-independent Yin (thin) / Yang (thick) lines; thickness flips when price breaks prior shoulder/waist. Line gauge encodes up vs down regime; doorstep in points or % of price sets reverse sensitivity; classic vs modified filters every move.
data_needed: Copied Close/Open/High/Low on chosen calculation TF; doorstep points or percent
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1/M30 examples; GBPUSD H4; #IBM H4 1%; calculation TF independent of chart
why_new_for_mis: Supplies MIS a binary thick/thin trend-regime label that ignores clock time and only advances on significant price travel.
quote: The chart represents a set of thick Yang and thin Yin lines replacing each other depending on the market situation.

idea_name: Consecutive Kagi shoulders/waists as exhaustion counter
mechanism: Count successive rising shoulders or falling waists; after ~7–10 in a row expect reversal. Use reversal price/time labels colored by Yin/Yang as change markers.
data_needed: Kagi shoulder/waist sequence and reversal timestamps from the indicator buffers
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a discrete exhaustion/change countdown on a time-agnostic swing series rather than clock-bar oscillators.
quote: after 7-10 successively increasing "shoulders" or decreasing "waists", there will certainly be a reversal (fall ot rise).

idea_name: Renko brick direction as time-free regime
mechanism: Fixed brick size (points or % of price) advances a new column only after price travels ≥ step; up bricks vs down bricks are the regime. Optional filter_number requires N bricks to reverse. Construction TF independent of chart TF.
data_needed: Copied price series (Close/Open/High/Low) on time_frame; step and type_step; optional reverse filter
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 30pt / Daily 25pt; GBPUSD H4 20pt; USDCHF H4 from H1; multi-TF overlay demos
why_new_for_mis: Provides MIS a pure price-threshold regime tape that compresses chop and emits state only on material moves.
quote: The Renko chart as the above mentioned charts ignores a timeline and is only concerned with price movement.

idea_name: Renko multi-brick shadow as volatility burst flag
mechanism: When one bar spawns several bricks, optional shadows mark the extreme that forced the burst; treat single-brick reversals as cleaner flips and multi-brick same-bar opens as high-velocity/unsafe entries.
data_needed: Renko brick series plus shadow_up/shadow_down from source bar extremes
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 20 points trade-signal demo (points A–F)
why_new_for_mis: Turns Renko brick multiplicity into a discrete volatility/impulse sensor MIS can gate alongside regime flips.
quote: The most favorable entrance to the market is when one reversal brick (look at the shadows) is created with one movement. If we two bricks are created at a time, this entrance may be unsafe.

idea_name: Three Line Break consecutive-line trend regime
mechanism: Lines advance only on new close extrema; reversal needs break of last N identical lines (classic N=3; configurable line_to_back). White vs black consecutive lines encode trend regime; min step filters noise.
data_needed: OHLC (or single price) on calculation TF; step_min points; line_to_back count
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1/H4; GBPUSD H1; USDCAD M30 modified; from 2013–2014 demos
why_new_for_mis: Adds MIS a N-line confirmation regime that withholds flips until prior swing structure is broken.
quote: To draw a line in the direction opposite to the previous movement, the minimum or maximum have to be passed. At the same time, if there is more than one identical line, then the minimum or maximum is calculated based on two (if there are two consecutive identical lines) or three (if there are three or more consecutive identical lines) of them.

idea_name: Three-line reversal break as confirmed change event
mechanism: Emit a change signal when a reverse line prints beyond three consecutive same-direction lines (rule №2) or when three consecutive lines first establish a trend (rule №1); wait one confirming line in the new direction.
data_needed: Three Line Break line series with direction tags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 early-2013 classic Close construction
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS explicit confirmed-break change events on a filtered swing chart rather than raw candle flips.
quote: Sell, when the reversal line drops below three consecutive ascending lines, buy, when the reversal line is higher than three consecutive descending lines.

idea_name: Inside-bar range as consolidation breakout sensor
mechanism: Detect bar whose High/Low lie inside prior bar; place BuyStop at prior High and SellStop at prior Low (with offset). Pattern flags short consolidation and pending breakout levels for either direction.
data_needed: Two bars of High/Low on module TF; order offset points
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 inside-bar examples; module tested on H6 with AO H12 filter
why_new_for_mis: Provides MIS a binary consolidation→breakout level sensor from raw OHLC without lagging indicators.
quote: An inside bar is a bar having High and Low within the extrema of the previous bar. An inside bar indicates the beginning of consolidation or possible reversal of the price movement.

mechanism: Detect bar whose High/Low engulf prior bar; set pending entries on the outside bar's extrema. Marks volatility expansion and likely directional follow-through after absorption.
data_needed: Two bars of High/Low on module TF; order offset; TP:SL ratio
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 outside-bar examples; H6 module tests
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a one-bar volatility-expansion / absorption event distinct from ATR averages.
quote: Outside bar is called so because its High and Low overlap High and Low of the previous bar. Appearance of an outside bar is an indication of the volatility increase followed by a directed price movement.
